fact: On 21 September 2026 the Inspector General of Police said he would prosecute Jerry Nyantee Wrato under sections 10.1, 15.1, 18.1 and 19.1 of the Cybercrime Act of 2025 over AI-generated images and videos of the Vice President, the law's first high-profile case.
title: Liberia: Konneh Urges Balance in Cybercrime Law Enforcement
